faqs.question: Is the American Express Gold Charge Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The joining fee is ₹1,000 + GST and the annual fee is ₹4,500 + GST from the second year. There is no fee waiver based on spends.

faqs.question: Can I apply for the American Express Gold Charge Card now?
faqs.answer: No. American Express has paused new card applications in India. Existing cardholders can keep using the card.

faqs.question: What is the monthly milestone on the Amex Gold Charge Card?
faqs.answer: You get 1,000 bonus MR points when you make 6 transactions of ₹1,000 or more in a calendar month.

faqs.question: Does the Amex Gold Charge Card give reward points on fuel?
faqs.answer: No. Since 12 June 2025, fuel spends do not earn MR points. They still count towards the monthly milestone.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the American Express Gold Charge Card?
faqs.answer: It is 3.5% plus GST on spends in a foreign currency, so it is not a good card to use abroad.

faqs.question: Does the American Express Gold Charge Card give airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: No. The card does not include any complimentary domestic or international airport lounge access.

faqs.question: How much can I earn with the American Express Gold Charge Card?
faqs.answer: The base reward rate is about 0.7% to 1.2%, depending on how you redeem. With the monthly milestone, you can get about 6% to 11% back on ₹6,000 of spends a month.
